bugsResolved.problem: Quoted chat arguments like `base64 of "hello world"` retained bounding quotes, producing base64 of '"hello world"'
bugsResolved.rootCause: Regex in `genParse` matched `of (.+)$` without stripping wrapping quotes
bugsResolved.fix: Added quote trimming `.replace(/^["“']|["”']$/g, '')` before executing generator

bugsResolved.problem: Pressing ⌘K did not focus search input; locator('#pq') matched an inactive hidden duplicate component
bugsResolved.rootCause: GlobalModals rendered a duplicate inert CommandPalette holding id='pq' while the layout's active CommandPalette lacked id='pq'
bugsResolved.fix: Removed duplicate CommandPalette from GlobalModals, added id='pq' and autoFocus to active search CommandPalette, synced open event

bugsResolved.problem: Clicking Favourite button or breadcrumbs on tool pages timed out; pointer events intercepted by header
bugsResolved.rootCause: Fixed header (#nav) height 84px overlapped top 84px of main content on non-home routes
bugsResolved.fix: Added `#main > main { padding-top: calc(84px + 1.5rem); }` to provide dedicated clearance below fixed navigation

bugsResolved.rootCause: Native range slider had default height below 24px WCAG 2.2 target threshold
bugsResolved.fix: Added `h-6 min-h-[24px]` and cursor-pointer to quality input range slider

bugsResolved.problem: axe violation `light color-contrast` on tab buttons
bugsResolved.rootCause: Tabs inside bg-muted had low contrast on inactive tabs and unconstrained colors
bugsResolved.fix: Refactored tab container to bg-soft border-line with high-contrast text-ink2 and solid active pill (11:1 contrast)

bugsResolved.problem: PWA offline test timed out waiting for `navigator.serviceWorker.ready`
bugsResolved.rootCause: Script used `addEventListener('load')` which never fired if the hydration script executed after window load completed
bugsResolved.fix: Updated registration script to check `document.readyState === 'complete'` and register immediately if already loaded

bugsResolved.problem: Mobile friendly test failed on 34px horizontal overflow on homepage
bugsResolved.rootCause: DocumentElement lacked `overflow-x: clip`, allowing orbiting hero satellites to extend document scroll width
bugsResolved.fix: Added `overflow-x: clip` to `html` and streamlined mobile navigation `.kbtn` on screens <640px

bugsResolved.problem: Touch targets under 44px on header brand and theme icon button on small screens
bugsResolved.rootCause: Brand anchor was 38px tall; theme icon button shrank in flex row without min dimensions
bugsResolved.fix: Added min-height: 44px to `.brand` and min-width: 44px, min-height: 44px, flex-shrink: 0 to `.icon-btn`
